title: RES↔FE-001: Novel Data Visualization Requirements + Dashboard / Real-Time Rendering Feasibility
description: The Researcher provides novel data-type visualization requirements (what the data represents, how it should be represented, update frequency, domain-specific conventions), real-time streaming requirements (expected data rate, latency tolerance, rendering constraints), and ML-output presentation requirements (confidence scores, uncertainty, novel output formats); the Frontend/Dashboard Engineer provides a visualization-feasibility assessment (whether the data can be visualized with current tooling — Grafana, Plotly, D3.js, Recharts — or requires custom development), UX (User Experience) impact analysis, real-time-streaming compatibility, and accessibility implications against WCAG 2.1 AA (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1, Level AA). Grounded in IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.14 and FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.8. This single contract covers both the 'novel visualization requirements + dashboard feasibility' and 'visualization feasibility + real-time rendering of research data' framings (the same canonical RES↔FE pair).

research_visualization_requirements.description: RES→FE: novel data-type, real-time streaming, and ML-output presentation requirements.

representation.description: How the data should be visually represented.

frontend_feasibility.description: FE→RES: visualization feasibility, UX impact, real-time compatibility, accessibility.

ux_impact.description: New dashboard views, controls, or alerting surfaces field operators would need.

realtime_compatibility.description: Whether the data type's volume/velocity renders in a browser without performance degradation.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine visualization-feasibility assessment for research data is agent-autonomous (feasibility within 15 business days; real-time-streaming compatibility within 10 business days). New dashboard surfaces affecting field-operator workflows route to PO sign-off; any backend data/stream contract change routes through ARCH↔FE-001 / BACK↔FE-001.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (visualization-feasibility assessment within 15 business days; real-time-streaming compatibility within 10 business days; frontend-relevant findings transferred at the quarterly Technology Transfer Review; ad hoc consultation with 5 business days' notice)
confirm_conditions: each novel data type states its representation; update frequency, data rate, and latency tolerance carry explicit units
the visualization-feasibility verdict is stated; REQUIRES_CUSTOM_DEVELOPMENT carries a custom-dev estimate
real-time compatibility and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility are assessed for browser-rendered research data
ML-output presentation (confidence, uncertainty) semantics are specified where research models surface to operators
reject_conditions: a real-time requirement asserted as RENDERS_WITHOUT_DEGRADATION without a tested data-rate/latency basis (Honesty Over Polish §10.3)
an update frequency, data rate, or latency emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a novel visualization shipped that FAILS WCAG 2.1 AA presented as accessibility-compliant
counter_conditions: a novel data type's volume/velocity is unstated — request the data rate and latency tolerance before a compatibility verdict
a research visualization implies a new backend data/event contract — request that it be raised via ARCH↔FE-001 / BACK↔FE-001 before committing the dashboard
